cells.gaps: No source found says a rule on AI harms is in force; the Presidency called a deepfake of the president criminal in October 2025 without naming a law. No body is designated over AI.
cells.note: The draft Cybercrime Bill, which targets malicious deepfakes, was back in consultation in February 2026, which meets the draft rung. The February 2026 statement that Namibia lacks AI governance frameworks leaves no rule in force.
